## Featured Flagship Engineering Case Studies

### 1. Gemini Flow — Real-Time Voice Dictation & Audio DSP Engine
- Problem: Existing voice dictation tools suffer from high cloud latency and microphone background noise (ceiling fans, HVAC) polluting the audio stream.
- Architecture:
  - Real-time digital signal processing (DSP) frequency bandpass filter in Python stripping 50Hz–200Hz mechanical noise before audio serialization.
  - Dual-mode model router dynamically switching between local offline fallback and low-latency cloud SSE stream.
  - Single-click OS cursor injection via Win32 API hooks.
- Metrics: Reduced end-to-end transcription latency from 1.4s to <420ms; zero cloud dependency in offline fallback mode.
- Tech Stack: Python, Win32 API, Google Gemini Flash, DSP Audio Filters.
- Repository: https://github.com/SriniwasAwasthi/gemini-flow

### 2. Maison Noir — High-Fidelity Specialty Web Platform
- Problem: Modern e-commerce sites lack sensory immersion, suffer from sluggish state stores with high SKU counts, and lack international currency reactivity.
- Architecture:
  - Real-time Web Audio API node graph synthesizing ambient analog vinyl textures and acoustic warmth.
  - React 19 concurrent mode UI with zero-runtime Tailwind CSS v4 design tokens.
  - Multi-currency state store with cached exchange rate lookups and memoized checkout calculations.
- Metrics: 60fps audio node synthesis, sub-10ms cart state re-computation across 90+ luxury SKUs.
- Tech Stack: TypeScript, Next.js 15, React 19, Web Audio API, Tailwind CSS.
- Repository: https://github.com/SriniwasAwasthi/maison-noir-luxury-coffee

### 3. Java & DSA Adaptive Study Tracker
- Problem: Self-directed coding interview preparation suffers from rigid study plans and high retention decay without spaced repetition intervals.
- Architecture:
  - Algorithmic spaced repetition retention engine based on a SuperMemo (SM-2) memory decay curve variant.
  - Relational schema with indexed queries for fast progress analytics and dynamic study schedule re-balancing.
  - AI code review mentor utilizing structured JSON schema outputs for strict deterministic parsing.
- Metrics: 100% automated schedule re-balancing; 20+ problem curriculum coverage across Trees, Graphs, and DP.
- Tech Stack: Java, TypeScript, Next.js, Google Gemini API, Tailwind CSS.
- Repository: https://github.com/SriniwasAwasthi/java-dsa-tracker

### 4. Solaria Estates — 3D Real Estate Walkthrough Platform
- Problem: Traditional real estate listings rely on flat photos, causing low buyer engagement and poor spatial comprehension of luxury architectural properties.
- Architecture:
  - 150-frame camera flythrough scroll engine with desynchronized GPU canvas rendering.
  - Custom Web Audio procedural ocean soundscape generator adapting volume to scroll depth.
  - Modular state machine managing tour waypoints, floor plans, and inquiries.
- Metrics: Consistent 60fps GPU-accelerated canvas playback; zero third-party player dependencies.
- Tech Stack: TypeScript, Next.js 15, Canvas WebGL, Web Audio API, Tailwind CSS.
- Repository: https://github.com/SriniwasAwasthi/solaria-luxury-estates
